text: dsh-ezprot-plugin（DSH 插件，支持工具调用的客户端）：为蛋白质组学数据提供可追踪的分步分析。它向 DSH 注册分析工具并在系统提示中安排工作流程，可检查和整理原始表格、预检样本、设置比较组与批次，依次执行归一化、PCA、差异表达、GO/KEGG 富集和 GSEA，并汇总报告及图表。适合希望通过对话分析蛋白表达矩阵的研究者。使用前需要本地 R 环境或 Docker；首次构建注释背景需要联网。

dsh-ezprot-plugin (DSH tool plugin): guides proteomics analysis with tools for tidying data and running normalization, PCA, differential analysis, GO/KEGG enrichment, and GSEA. It returns summaries and a report. Requires local R or Docker; building annotation backgrounds needs network access once.
我想用对话完成蛋白质组表达数据分析。
能帮我从原始表格整理出蛋白矩阵并检查样本吗？
我需要比较不同实验组的蛋白表达差异。
想给蛋白组数据做归一化、PCA 和批次校正。
怎样对差异蛋白做 GO 或 KEGG 富集分析？
I need a guided workflow for analyzing proteomics expression data.
Help me compare protein abundance across sample groups and explore enriched pathways.
Can I run PCA and differential analysis on my protein matrix?
dsh-ezprot-plugin 的功能「原始表格导入」：检查 TSV、CSV 或 Excel 的列角色、缺失值及样本组推断，再按确认的列整理为标准矩阵和样本信息文件。
dsh-ezprot-plugin 的功能「分步蛋白质组分析」：在项目目录中按步骤执行归一化、PCA、批次移除、差异分析、富集和 GSEA，并返回步骤摘要与图表路径。
dsh-ezprot-plugin 的功能「分析结果汇总」：对已完成的项目汇总步骤状态、各比较的差异蛋白数量、GO/KEGG 条目及 GSEA 集合。
dsh-ezprot-plugin 使用前须知：首次构建 GO/KEGG 注释背景会访问 KEGG REST 与 UniProt，之后背景缓存供富集步骤本地使用。

dsh-ezprot-plugin README · dsh-ezprot-plugin：A plug-and-play **proteomics analysis plugin for DeepSeek Harness**. It wraps a full protein-expression analysis workflow — normalization → PCA → batch correction → differential analysis → GO/KEGG enrichment → GSEA — behind a conversation: give the agent your data file, answer a few questions (which columns are what, which groups to compare), and the plugin prepares everything automatically and walks through every step with visible summaries and figures, ending with an interpretation report.

dsh-ezprot-plugin README · dsh-ezprot-plugin：No R or terminal knowledge required: the plugin detects or silently installs its own R 4.4.0 runtime and package library on first use (one-time, ~10–20 min). Docker is optional: the plugin switches to a Docker backend automatically when a usable local R cannot be set up, and can run the one-time GO/KEGG background build inside the image on network-restricted machines.

dsh-ezprot-plugin README · From the DSH Desktop plugin market：1. Settings → Plugins → Plugin market → Sources → **Add standard source**.
2. Enter `https://dsh-plugin.yukunr.top/catalog-source.json`.
3. Open **Discover**, search `ezprot`, and install `dsh-ezprot-plugin` from
   the card — Desktop re-verifies the exact version and the active profile
   before installing.
4. Restart Desktop and start a session: the `proteomics_*` tools are ready.

A step-by-step guide with screenshots: [安装指南 (中文)](docs/install.zh.md).
section: From the DSH Desktop plugin market

text:
dsh-ezprot-plugin README · From the command line：Prerequisites: Node.js (bundles `npx`) and pnpm — `npm install -g pnpm`.

Requires the [`dsh`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) CLI (Windows / macOS / Linux), one command:

```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ezprot-plugin@0.1.1
```

If `dsh` is already installed globally, drop the `npx @deepseek-ai/` prefix:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ezprot-plugin@0.1.1
```

Then restart `dsh web`. Every session's agent gains the `proteomics_*` tools.

dsh-ezprot-plugin README · Usage：Just talk to the agent. For example:

> My proteomics data is at `D:\my-experiment\origin_data.txt` with sample groups in `D:\my-experiment\sample_info.txt`, mouse samples. Compare HC and HD against NC.

dsh-ezprot-plugin README · Usage：The agent will inspect and QC your data, confirm the comparisons with you, run the analysis step by step, and write an interpretation report (top proteins, enriched pathways, candidate targets). Detailed instructions: [biologist's guide](docs/biologist-guide.md) ([中文](docs/biologist-guide.zh.md)).
